watch.summary: A Rocket League player gets cleanly outplayed by an opponent who scores, leading him to express disbelief and candidly admit how hard the game is.

beats.what: Creator plays a tight match of Rocket League.
Creator exclaims in disbelief that he was read like a book.
Creator reads a chat question about ranking up and admits he is struggling.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: He read me like a book, bro! What the flip?
watch.why: The comedy stems from the relatable frustration of getting predicted and outplayed, paired with an honest, self-aware admission of struggling to rank up. It is standard gameplay banter that relies on the streamer's expressive reaction.
